name: oh
description: Supervise Claude Code and Codex sessions in a native Mac app, share one Vercel Board, and pair machines over Cloudflare Tunnel.

interface.longDescription:
Supervise Claude Code and Codex sessions in a native Mac app, share one Vercel Board, and pair machines over Cloudflare Tunnel.

Requires the separately installed OH app and its local command on Apple silicon with macOS 15.0 or later.
